criteria.requirement: Ordinary input completes harvest, full cargo, sale and purchase with consistent feedback. Return/rescue results show actual kept/lost cargo and retained materials; failed saves do not report purchases, and current-visit recap clears on new departure/restart.

Both fixed regions, single-serving flowers, a useful short material branch and far destination are usable through ordinary input. Weather and redundant loops/shortcuts are removed per Alan SD-v1.7. Hub/pond/meadow stay distinct; return lands at the dance gate; sale/growth/departure remain reachable. Flowers and materials visibly grow, mature, fade and replenish during active play; pause/cold resume preserve phases. Growth uses actual purchased upgrades, action ranges and fewer-hit gains remain visible. Harvest selection/partial progress and Q/right-click direction/empty-free/charge-dash precedence remain valid. Collision and resource affordances match scenery. Dance skip/reduced-motion and saving remain valid.

Twelve applicable upgrade purchases (obsolete shortcut removed), economy, reserve completion and invalid/duplicate transactions pass rules checks. Resource conservation, lifecycle, stamina/capacity/harvest growth and strict regional persistence are included. Existing v1–v4 to v5 migration tests still pass; old Nectar and greybox saves remain untouched in their namespaces.
Pause/focus loss clears input; actual shutdown and cold resume preserve current and permanent state without legacy-save interference.

Native 960x600 and 1280x800 presentation is readable, coherent and spatially credible. Dance stage supports, art family, field guide and settings are checked at native scales. Home/flower/material waymarks, off-screen return bearing, capacity appearance and sealed home reserve are checked at both scales. Selected flower work/nectar trail, directional gust, carried material loosening/drop/pickup and legible growth detail must agree with the rules. SD16: growth, destination, pause, shop, settings, completion, HUD resources and scene waymarks must share the painted garden family. No geometric hexagon waymark or oversized flat modal may stand in for the requested visual revision.
Complete ordinary-input native media and independent review, with no unresolved basic defect and honest actor/evidence boundaries.
Same frozen source/export, direct app and maintained command entry, input, save, exit, cold resume and old-save isolation are tested; old-save hashes correspond to retained before/after bytes.
Measured effort and unknowns, tracking readback, CI/integration state and candidate-only status are recorded accurately.
